steps.content: You feign an injury, dropping to the ground, but your plan backfires instantly. Helene directly trips over your body and stumbles past.
The sharp point of her heel digs viciously into your side. You hear a sickening crack as your ribs protest.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: ${PlayerName}! My goodness, ${PlayerName}, are you all right?!
Her voice is frantic. She crouches down, her hands fluttering over your body as you gasp, fighting for air.
Helene collapses. No cry, no final word. Just a silent, heavy thud against the floor.
You clutch the searing pain in your chest. Thick, acrid smoke and blooming flames swarm your vision.
Through the shimmering inferno, a dark silhouette stands firm, raising a gun toward you.
